I'm new to VRChat and this is something I was shocked to find out. I was trying to figure out how to change my PTT key since I have a button on my mouse I usually dedicate to it and V is a really inconvenient binding for it since I can't really talk and move at the same time. 

Super weird that a game as big as VRChat doesn't have this basic functionality.
and it still isn't in the game... I want this.

details:
Currently, VR users are able to change their keybinds, but Desktop users are not able to change their keybinds.
For example, if a player wants to change their gesture keys to a separate key, such as numpad, or unbind/rebind the safe mode because people may use it accidently, it would be a very useful tool.
You used to be able to change your keybinds on Desktop using the input menu from Unity, but this was removed, so now players are completely stuck with the default keybinds.
I'm not sure why this feature was removed, because tons of other games, quite literally 90% of them, allow you to change your controls and keybinds. 
This is really good feature for accessibility reasons as well, such as people who prefer to use arrow keys or IJKL instead of WASD.
title: Ability to Change Keybinds
